# Convert a camt.053 or MT940 bank statement to OFX, QBO, QIF or a Xero CSV

> Free camt.053 and MT940 converter: balance-check the statement, then download OFX/QBO for QuickBooks and Quicken, QIF, or a Xero statement CSV, with stable transaction IDs. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
